defaultModel.description: OpenCode provider/model id when stance has no override (see upstream docs).

localPreferredStances.description: Stances where operators should prefer local/fast models when configuring providers.

defaultOlfactoryThreshold.description: Default minimum computed intensity for stigmergy_actionable when the tool omits olfactory_threshold.

defaultActionableLimit.description: Default max rows returned when the tool omits limit.

maxActionable.description: Hard cap on actionable list size (bounds fan-out); applies after default/explicit limit.
